title: LessLeak-Bench: A First Investigation of Data Leakage in LLMs Across 83 Software Engineering Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring data leakage (contamination) by detecting near-duplicate data pairs between software engineering benchmark datasets and LLM pre-training corpora using MinHash+LSH and manual verification, and comparing LLM performance (Pass@k) on leaked versus non-leaked data to quantify metric inflation.
